thesis: This episode argues that the AI trend is creating a massive opportunity for the three dominant cloud companies (Google, Amazon, Microsoft) and Nvidia, which is driving enormous demand for GPUs and servers. It suggests that margins for these giants have increased over the last decade and that they own a significant portion of the server supply chain.
